fusions.name: Snatch the Dose
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 16 damage, uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 60% more damage for each one, and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Switched Cups
fusions.desc: Throws a dosed cup that deals 11 poison damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Drink It Yourself
fusions.desc: For 7 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 60% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.

fusions.name: Poisoner's Poise
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your dodge chance rises by 12%. You have 10% poison resistance.
